title: Weak under powered.
text: Weak under powered.. I’ve had this for about six months and it can barely open one bottle with a full charge now. Forget about two or more. I’d like to return it but I can’t find a way on the mobile app. Cant even contact seller for warranty information.

product_metadata.title: Secura Electrical Wine Bottle Opener
features: Cordless electric wine bottle opener removes and releases the cork in seconds. Foil cutter included for easily removing seals
Durable and elegant Stainless Steel housing with see through mechanism, no guess work needed. Elegant charging base with blue LED light
Built-in rechargeable battery, opens up to 30 bottles on a single charge
Built-in thermometer with digital display, reads and displays wine temperature with the push of a button
